requirements.quote:
A STOP_SENDING frame can be sent for streams in the "Recv" or "Size
   Known" states; see Section 3.2.  Receiving a STOP_SENDING frame for a
requirements.condition: When an endpoint sends a STOP_SENDING frame for a stream.
requirements.required_behavior: The stream is in the "Recv" or "Size Known" state.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Sending the frame for a stream in any other state.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can inspect the stream state at the point a STOP_SENDING frame is emitted.

requirements.quote:
locally initiated stream that has not yet been created MUST be
   treated as a connection error of type STREAM_STATE_ERROR.  An
requirements.condition: When a STOP_SENDING frame is received for a locally initiated stream that has not yet been created.
requirements.error_behavior: Treat receipt as a connection error of type STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the frame for an uncreated locally initiated stream and verify the connection error type.

requirements.quote:
endpoint that receives a STOP_SENDING frame for a receive-only stream
   MUST terminate the connection with error STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.condition: When an endpoint receives a STOP_SENDING frame for a receive-only stream.
requirements.error_behavior: Terminate the connection with error STREAM_STATE_ERROR.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can deliver the frame for a receive-only stream and observe connection termination and its error code.

requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Encode and recognize the frame Type as a variable-length integer with value 0x05.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treating a frame with another Type value as a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.why_checkable: Encoded frames can be inspected and decoder dispatch can be tested against the fixed type value.

requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Include the fields in this order: Type, Stream ID, Application Protocol Error Code.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Omitting, duplicating, or reordering these fields in the STOP_SENDING frame format.
requirements.why_checkable: The serialized field sequence can be compared directly with the specified frame layout.

requirements.quote:
Stream ID:  A variable-length integer carrying the stream ID of the
      stream being ignored.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Stream ID field of a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent it as a variable-length integer that identifies the stream being ignored.
requirements.why_checkable: A codec test can verify both the integer encoding and correspondence to the targeted stream.

requirements.quote:
Application Protocol Error Code:  A variable-length integer
      containing the application-specified reason the sender is ignoring
      the stream; see Section 20.2.
requirements.condition: When encoding or decoding the Application Protocol Error Code field of a STOP_SENDING frame.
requirements.required_behavior: Represent it as a variable-length integer containing the application-specified reason for ignoring the stream.
requirements.why_checkable: A codec test can verify the field's variable-length integer representation and its preservation of the supplied application error code.
